land.text: Jamaica, which with nine other colonies formed the Federation in 1958

predecessors.note: The Cayman Islands and Turks and Caicos were attached to Jamaica, not members.

land.text: Trinidad and Tobago, Barbados, Antigua, Dominica, Grenada, Montserrat, St Christopher-Nevis-Anguilla, Saint Lucia and St Vincent

predecessors.note: Cliopatria's British Colonial Empire row (1706-1999) is the aggregate that contains these colonies; no separate row exists.

land.text: Jamaica left after the September 1961 referendum ('54% in favour of leaving') and became independent on 6 August 1962

successors.note: Dissolved legally by the UK's West Indies Act 1962.

land.text: Trinidad and Tobago, whose PNM 'passed a resolution rejecting any further involvement with the Federation' on 14 January 1962 and became independent on 31 August 1962
the remaining islands, 'left ... as separate colonies again'

successors.note: Barbados became independent in 1966 and Grenada in 1974 (page).

capitals.name: Port of Spain (de facto; Chaguaramas de jure)
capitals.note: Infobox: "Chaguaramas (de jure); Port of Spain (de facto)"; Port of Spain served as the de facto capital for the whole existence.

correction.text: Jamaica and nine other colonies: Antigua, Barbados, Dominica, Grenada, Montserrat, St Christopher-Nevis-Anguilla, Saint Lucia, St Vincent and Trinidad and Tobago

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, Cliopatria has no row. The page gives the federation's total area as 20,239 km2; the gazetteer resolves the eleven modern countries to 91 cells, about 23,000 km2 (ratio 1.14, within a factor of two). The Cayman Islands and Turks and Caicos were attached to Jamaica and are not included.

region.text: Jamaica and the other nine colonies

ledger.note: 3 January 1958: the West Indies Federation is established. Infobox 'Established: 3 January 1958'; 'The federation was created by the United Kingdom in 1958 from most of the British West Indies' and was 'made up of ten provinces, all British colonial possessions' (quotes corrected by the reviewer am-08-x, 2026-10-19: the earlier quote is not on this page); federal elections were held on 25 March 1958.

region.text: the Federation, dissolved by the West Indies Act 1962

ledger.note: 31 May 1962: the West Indies Federation is dissolved. Infobox 'Disestablished: 31 May 1962'; Jamaica's referendum of September 1961 was '54% in favour of leaving the Federation' and Trinidad and Tobago's PNM rejected the Federation on 14 January 1962; the islands became separate colonies again.

certainty.note: Island colonies with coasts as frontiers; no land frontier.

sources.title: West Indies Federation
sources.note: Infobox (3 January 1958 to 31 May 1962), capital, members, area 20,239 km2, Jamaica referendum September 1961, Trinidad resolution 14 January 1962.

notes:
Cliopatria has no row for the Federation. Type state: it had its own capital, parliament and Prime Minister (Sir Grantley Adams) and Governor-General (Lord Hailes) per the page, but the member colonies stayed colonies; the colour agent may prefer umbrella. Jamaica and Trinidad and Tobago left in fact in September 1961 and January 1962; the dossier keeps all members to the legal dissolution of 31 May 1962.
One page opened (budget 1-2); the Jamaica referendum day (19 September 1961) is not on the page, only 'September 1961'. The members' own colonial dossiers do not exist except colony-of-jamaica (written in this batch); the other predecessors are the aggregate british-colonial-empire row.
